title.en: Production Agent Runtimes — Fast Instantiation and Typed Workflows

hook: A production agent runtime optimizes what prototyping frameworks ignore: instantiation cost, typed workflow surfaces, and a serving-ready backend. The 2026 pairing: Agno (Python) aims at microsecond agent instantiation and stateless FastAPI backends. Mastra ships agents, tools, workflows, unified model routing, and composite storage on the Vercel AI SDK substrate.
